summary: This note is a Wikipedia-style article about the song "...Baby One More Time" by American singer Britney Spears, the title track of her 1999 debut studio album. The song was written and produced by Max Martin (with Rami credited as producer), and it was recorded after Spears sent a demo tape and signed a multi-album deal with Jive. Lyrically it describes a girl's feelings after a breakup with her boyfriend, and the single was released September 30, 1998 with "Autumn Goodbye" as its B-side.
one_line: A 1998 teen pop single by Britney Spears, written and produced by Max Martin, that became the title track of her 1999 debut album.
key_facts: "...Baby One More Time" is a song recorded by American singer Britney Spears.
The song is from Britney Spears's debut studio album of the same title, released in 1999.
The song was written by Max Martin and produced by Max Martin and Rami.
After recording and sending a demo tape with an unused song from Toni Braxton, Spears signed a multi-album deal with Jive.
The song is a pop song that refers to a girl's feelings after a break-up with her boyfriend.
The single was released on September 30, 1998.
The single was issued in cassette, CD and 12-inch formats.
The song was recorded in 1998 at Cheiron Studios in Stockholm, Sweden.
The song's genre is listed as teen pop and dance-pop.
The song's length is listed as 3:31.
The B-side of the single is "Autumn Goodbye".
The song was listed as the first single in Britney Spears's singles chronology, followed by "Sometimes" (1999).
The note includes a link to the music video for "...Baby One More Time" on YouTube.
